import json

    )

"""Request handlers."""

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from app.services import users

_SLUG_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "scripts" / "slug.py"

        return False
    return any(char.isascii() and char.isalnum() for char in title)

        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}

    if user is None:
        return 404, {"error": "not found"}

        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    slug = json.loads(result.stdout)["slug"]
    return 200, {"slug": slug}

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/repo")
from app.api.handlers import handle_make_slug as h

cases = [
    ({"title": "Hello World"}, (200, {"slug": "hello-world"})),
    ({"title": "Hello, World!"}, (200, {"slug": "hello-world"})),
    ({"title": "Python 3.12"}, (200, {"slug": "python-3-12"})),
    ({"title": "a"}, (200, {"slug": "a"})),
    ({"title": "1"}, (200, {"slug": "1"})),
    ({"title": "x" * 80}, (200, {"slug": "x" * 80})),
    ({"title": "-abc-"}, (200, {"slug": "abc"})),
    ({"title": "-1-"}, (200, {"slug": "1"})),
    ({"title": "--title"}, (200, {"slug": "title"})),
    ({"title": "  leading and trailing  "}, (200, {"slug": "leading-and-trailing"})),
    ({"title": "caf\u00e9 au lait"}, (200, {"slug": "caf-au-lait"})),
    ({"title": "a\nb"}, (200, {"slug": "a-b"})),
    # invalid
    ({}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
    ({"title": None}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
    ({"title": 123}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
    ({"title": ["x"]}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
    ({"title": ""}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
    ({"title": "x" * 81}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
    ({"title": "!!!"}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
    ({"title": "   "}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
    ({"title": "---"}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
    ({"title": "\u00e9\u00e9\u00e9"}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
    ({"title": "\u0663\u0664"}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
    ({"title": "\u00b2"}, (400, {"error": "invalid title"})),
]

fails = 0
for params, expected in cases:
    try:
        got = h(params)
    except Exception as e:
        got = f"EXC {type(e).__name__}: {e}"
    status = "ok " if got == expected else "FAIL"
    if got != expected:
        fails += 1
    print(f"{status} {params!r} -> {got!r}")
print("FAILS:", fails)
